children: First Guaranty Bancshares declared a quarterly distribution of $0.421875 per depositary share, payable December 1, 2026.
Each depositary share represents a 1/40th interest in the company's 6.75% Series A preferred stock.
The distribution reflects a quarterly cash dividend of $16.875 per share of Series A preferred stock.
Holders of record on November 15, 2026, are eligible to receive the distribution on December 1, 2026.
